decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit fits the firm's core application-technology portfolio and likely serves demanding construction and sealing users who value reliable, tailored equipment.
A second two-component resin injection unit supports the firm's strategy of covering diverse specifications with customized solutions, so it is worth retaining after only a short time on the market.
An automatic airless spray gun is directly aligned with the firm's established coating business and strengthens its offer to industrial users seeking precise, repeatable application.
The manual airless spray gun complements the firm's broad spray-equipment range and serves customers who need robust, flexible application tools across varied job sites.
The air-assisted airless spray gun extends the firm's core finishing and coating lineup into higher-quality application needs and is consistent with its precision-and-reliability positioning.
The data logger adds process monitoring and service value to coating equipment, supporting innovation and differentiation even if it is less traditional than the firm's hardware products.
